# Senegalese Consulting & Services

> Dakar-based professional support for interpretation, translation and mission logistics in Senegal.

Senegalese Consulting & Services helps companies, NGOs, international organisations, consultants and visiting teams prepare professional assignments in Senegal. Availability, scope and arrangements should be confirmed directly with the team.

## Main services
- Professional interpretation: https://consultingservicessn-lab.github.io/senegalese-consulting-services/interpretation.html
- Professional translation: https://consultingservicessn-lab.github.io/senegalese-consulting-services/traduction.html
- Mission logistics: https://consultingservicessn-lab.github.io/senegalese-consulting-services/logistique.html
- Mission support: https://consultingservicessn-lab.github.io/senegalese-consulting-services/missions.html
- Security and protection coordination: https://consultingservicessn-lab.github.io/senegalese-consulting-services/securite.html
